label: ANALYTIC_PREDICTION

prediction_rule.statement: Derived I adds exactly 0.3 to the pre-activation, because w_I = 0.3. It removes a counterexample IFF the resulting pre-activation reaches the x at which C crosses the 0.30 boundary.
prediction_rule.mechanism: I_derived corrects the authority of I but not of V. Where V is small the added 0.3 does not lift the score out of L0, so the counterexample survives. Where V is large it does.

non_claims: does not predict that I_derived resolves D1b in general
does not predict anything about V, N or P beyond their remaining agent influence
does not predict that C is a valid policy
does not predict any cross outcome other than the per-case levels above
derived I removing one counterexample is not a security result

falsification_direction.if_execution_matches: prediction is consistent with the rules; the rules are not thereby confirmed
falsification_direction.if_execution_differs: adjudicate against the oracle first, then classify as execution or instrument defect, then as policy finding
falsification_direction.forbidden: adjusting the prediction after observing results, and adjusting k, thresholds, V or the hypothesis
